name: Hours
overview: The Scriptures in Matthew 20:3-8 reveal the significance of specific hours during the day as moments of divine invitation and labor in the kingdom of God. The third, sixth, ninth, and eleventh hours mark times when the master calls workers to the vineyard, illustrating God's sovereign grace in calling individuals at various times. This passage highlights the principle of God's just and generous reward, given regardless of when one begins to serve, emphasizing His mercy and the value of faithful labor until the end of the day.
